items.title: INI-03 Partner optimization: initiative business case (synthetic)

sections.strategicRationale: Partner cost pressure -> Partner model + analytics -> cost/MB, margin (B0147). Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.baselineSummary: May 2026 baseline: partner cost 0.012 SAR per MB on 80,000,000 MB per month. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.interventionsSummary: Partner renegotiation for the highest-cost partners, backed by partner usage analytics.
sections.investmentSummary: Cash: vendor cost 900,000 SAR for the partner analytics service.
sections.benefitsSummary: Margin uplift 1,920,000 SAR at the annual run-rate at target (formula BF-03).
sections.benefitRamp: Monthly ramp from July 2026 to the December 2026 targets.
sections.recurrenceSummary: Recurring benefit; the investment is approved once.
sections.decisionAskText: Fund INI-03: Cash: vendor cost 900,000 SAR for the partner analytics service. (synthetic demonstration).

items.title: INI-01 Pass redesign + digital activation: initiative business case (synthetic)

sections.strategicRationale: Low activation -> Proposition + journey -> attach rate / activation (B0147). Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.baselineSummary: May 2026 baseline: attach rate 18 % of 220,000 travelling customers per month. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.interventionsSummary: Roaming pass architecture redesign and one-tap digital activation in the app.
sections.investmentSummary: Cash: capex 2,400,000 SAR for the digital roaming activation platform.
sections.benefitsSummary: Revenue uplift 7,128,000 SAR at the annual run-rate at target (formula BF-01).
sections.benefitRamp: Monthly ramp from July 2026 to the December 2026 targets.
sections.recurrenceSummary: Recurring benefit; the investment is approved once.
sections.decisionAskText: Fund INI-01: Cash: capex 2,400,000 SAR for the digital roaming activation platform. (synthetic demonstration).

sections.strategicRationale: Make international roaming effortless, trusted and economically accretive. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.baselineSummary: May 2026 baseline: attach rate 18 %, complaint rate 3.5 %, partner cost 0.012 SAR per MB. Synthetic demonstration value (illustrative example; not Mobily actual performance).
sections.valuePoolsSummary: Revenue from activation, avoided care cost from fewer complaints, wholesale margin from partner cost.
sections.interventionsSummary: Pass redesign + digital activation; proactive comms + QoS monitoring; partner optimization.
sections.investmentSummary: Cash: capex 2,400,000 SAR, opex 360,000 SAR, vendor cost 900,000 SAR. Non-cash: 6.5 internal FTE (1,170,000 SAR).
sections.benefitsSummary: Annual run-rate at target: revenue uplift 7,128,000 SAR; avoided care cost 1,584,000 SAR; margin uplift 1,920,000 SAR. Each is a separate value basis and is never added to another basis or to costs.
sections.benefitRamp: Monthly ramp from July 2026 to the December 2026 targets.
sections.recurrenceSummary: Recurring benefits; the activation platform is a one-off investment.
sections.keyAssumptions: 220,000 travelling customers and 80,000,000 MB of roaming data per month; pass ARPU 45 SAR; 60 SAR per complaint. All assumptions are synthetic and must be replaced with validated company data (B0144).
sections.downsideCase: Attach rate reaches 21 % only; partner renegotiation slips one quarter.
sections.upsideCase: Attach rate reaches 26 %; partner cost reaches 0.0095 SAR per MB.
sections.decisionAskText: Fund the activation platform and the partner analytics service (synthetic demonstration).
